_note: R2 的第二条路线：为 02-meaning.ttl 里的每个 :Definition 手写一条独立的列级谓词（凡能用正则/NOT IN 表达的就换一种写法，避免逐字抄编译产物），再由 check_ontology_generic --truth 逐类比对 count(*)。这张表不是声明的一部分，是证据：如果哪天谓词被改坏，这里会先红。

OldModelItem: side IN ('front','back') AND part_no !~ '^(M3|T14|T15|H128|H129)' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_master mm WHERE mm.part_no = std_time.part_no)
OldModelRow: kind_a = '架' AND timeliness <> '不計' AND part_no !~ '^(M3|T14|T15|H128|H129)' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_master mm WHERE mm.part_no = production_row.part_no)
MissingStdRow: kind_a = '架' AND timeliness <> '不計' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM std_time st WHERE st.part_no = production_row.part_no AND st.side = CASE WHEN production_row.work_center_desc = 'SH分公司前工序' THEN 'front' ELSE 'back' END)
EfficiencyPerson: person_class = '生產-纳入效率计算' AND kpi_attr NOT IN ('做辦','浮動')
